name: LibreCAD
description_it: CAD 2D open source leggero e multipiattaforma, con layer, quote e blocchi; lavora nativamente in DXF.
description_en: Lightweight, cross-platform open-source 2D CAD with layers, dimensions and blocks; works natively in DXF.

name: FreeCAD
description_it: Modellatore parametrico 3D open source con ambienti per architettura e BIM (IFC), disegno tecnico e analisi FEM.
description_en: Open-source parametric 3D modeller with workbenches for architecture and BIM (IFC), drawings and FEM analysis.

name: QCAD
description_it: CAD 2D per disegno tecnico e architettonico; la Community Edition è open source, la versione Pro aggiunge il DWG.
description_en: 2D CAD for technical and architectural drawing; the Community Edition is open source, Pro adds DWG.

name: ODA File Converter
description_it: Converte file DWG e DXF tra le diverse versioni, anche in blocco: utile quando un file è troppo recente per il tuo CAD.
description_en: Converts DWG and DXF files between versions, in batch too: handy when a file is too new for your CAD.

name: SolveSpace
description_it: CAD parametrico 2D/3D leggerissimo con vincoli geometrici, ideale per dettagli e componenti.
description_en: Very lightweight parametric 2D/3D CAD with geometric constraints, ideal for details and components.

name: OpenSCAD
description_it: Modellazione 3D solida tramite script: forme definite da codice, perfette per oggetti parametrici e stampa 3D.
description_en: Script-based solid 3D modelling: code-defined shapes, ideal for parametric objects and 3D printing.

name: CadQuery
description_it: Libreria Python per creare modelli CAD parametrici precisi (B-rep) esportabili in STEP.
description_en: Python library for building precise parametric CAD models (B-rep), exportable to STEP.

name: BRL-CAD
description_it: Sistema CAD di modellazione solida sviluppato in origine per l'esercito USA, oggi open source.
description_en: Solid modelling CAD system originally developed for the US Army, now open source.

name: Dune 3D
description_it: CAD 3D parametrico open source moderno, con vincoli e geometria solida basata su OpenCASCADE.
description_en: Modern open-source parametric 3D CAD with constraints and OpenCASCADE-based solid geometry.

name: LibreDWG
description_it: Libreria GNU per leggere e scrivere file DWG, con utility per convertirli in DXF, JSON e SVG.
description_en: GNU library to read and write DWG files, with utilities to convert them to DXF, JSON and SVG.

name: ezdxf
description_it: Libreria Python per creare e modificare file DXF: automatizza tavole, blocchi e quote.
description_en: Python library to create and edit DXF files: automate drawings, blocks and dimensions.
